reason: I lost an order last month only because someone else quoted first, so speed of quoting is a real problem for us. Rs 5,000 for a 14-day pilot on our own price list with money back is a small bet, and I can show my father actual quotes before we commit to the Rs 60,000.
objection: Our chemical rates move almost daily and many enquiries are vague (grade, packing, freight, credit terms), so I doubt a draft from an Excel sheet will be right 7 times out of 10. I also worry whether it really pulls IndiaMART leads reliably, and I don't want our customer-specific pricing sitting with a small outside firm.
